bc84626e35e3d1cd.description: Radiant Hospitality is partnering with a Riyadh-based hospitality investment group to appoint a Restaurant Manager for a premium lifestyle restaurant in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is the senior front-of-house role on site, owning the guest experience, the service team and the day-to-day running of the dining room. The restaurant is the Riyadh home of an internationally recognised, design-led dining brand with sister restaurants in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, set in a riverside heritage dining quarter overlooking a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is a lively, fashionable room with a terrace, a strong private dining and events offer, and VIP and corporate clientele, and the role comes with a tax-free package and visa sponsorship. Reporting to the General Manager and deputising in their absence, the Restaurant Manager leads Floor Managers, Supervisors, Captains, Waiters, Hosts, Runners and Bussers. We are looking for a natural host with warmth, presence and polish, who leads from the floor, develops people into loyal, high-performing teams, and balances an exceptional guest experience with commercial results. Responsibilities Lead daily front-of-house operations: service standards, opening/closing, cash control and end-of-day reporting, with a strong floor presence during service. Own the guest experience: feedback, online reviews, complaint resolution, reservations, waitlist management and VIP/regular engagement. Partner with the Head Chef on service pace, menu changes, specials and allergen communication. Recruit, train and develop the FOH team with the General Manager, building succession for supervisors; lead briefings, rotas, performance reviews, grooming and discipline in line with Saudi labour law. Deliver revenue, average spend and labour cost targets; drive upselling, promotions and monitor voids, discounts and cash variances. Maintain premises, equipment, operating supplies and presentation of the dining room, bar, terrace and entrance; manage breakages, wastage and maintenance follow-up. Ensure compliance with health and safety, food hygiene, SFDA requirements, licensing, security and incident reporting. Represent and protect the brand in Riyadh, supporting events, private dining, marketing activations and seasonal campaigns. Minimum 6 years in front-of-house roles in premium or lifestyle restaurants, with at least 2 years as Restaurant Manager or Assistant Restaurant Manager. Proven experience leading a front-of-house team of 20 or more in a high-volume, high-expectation venue with VIP and corporate clientele. GCC experience preferred; Saudi Arabia experience an advantage. Strong command of sequence of service, table management and reservations strategy. Confident with POS, reservations and rostering platforms, and competent with cash control and shift reporting. Working knowledge of labour cost management and operational reporting. Fluent English; Arabic an advantage. Food hygiene certification (for example HACCP Level 2 or 3) preferred. Strong food and beverage knowledge, with the ability to train and assess others. Calm and decisive under pressure, organised, detail-oriented, culturally aware and commercially minded. Must hold the right to work in Saudi Arabia, or be eligible to obtain it with the client's support. Salary: SAR 20,000 per month total package, tax-free, depending on experience. Performance bonus. Duty meal on shift. Uniform provided. Housing and transport allowances included, medical insurance, service charge eligibility, annual flight and visa sponsorship. Further benefits to be confirmed during the recruitment process. This is a full-time, permanent position working six days per week, including evenings, weekends and public holidays as required. The Restaurant Manager reports to the General Manager, with a target start date of 15 November 2026, so candidates available at short notice will be prioritised. The role is based in Riyadh. Candidates must hold the right to work in Saudi Arabia, or be eligible to obtain it; the client will sponsor the work visa for the successful applicant. We appreciate your interest in this vacancy. Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates selected to move to the next stage of the recruitment process can be contacted. Radiant does not charge any fee to candidates; all costs are always covered by the client.

bc060131d2787d48.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك التخطيط وتوزيع المهام وتطوير الفريق. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المهام الرئيسية يتولى مشرف الصيانة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وفعالية عمليات الصيانة. تشمل هذه المهام: إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الشامل للصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في توزيع المهام وإدارة فريق العمل. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم برامج تطوير المهارات. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات التي تساهم في نجاح مشرف الصيانة، منها: مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال. مهارات تحليلية لتقدير التكاليف والمواد. مهارات التواصل الفعال مع أعضاء الفريق والإدارة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مشرف الصيانة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في جميع أعمال الصيانة. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات.

bcf00d0870abb905.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكوين للصناعات المعدنية عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، تحديد القطع التبديلية، وتشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها الأولية. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية لأغراض الصيانة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات بدقة، ومتابعة جميع مراحل إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات. فهم قوي لآليات عمل المحركات الميكانيكية ومكوناتها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية ومواصفات القطع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإيجاد الحلول الفعالة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة في قطاع الصناعات المعدنية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

bcf7c7906594f480.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels (KSA) is seeking a Commi Chef for Café Boulud in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting the kitchen team in preparing and producing high-quality dishes, adhering to Four Seasons standards, Café Boulud recipes, and established food safety and hygiene procedures. The Commi Chef will work closely with the culinary team to ensure efficient kitchen operations. Key Responsibilities Assist with the preparation and production of food items according to Café Boulud recipes, standards, and specifications. Complete daily mise en place and ensure the assigned station is properly prepared before service. Support the Chef de Partie and Sous Chef with the preparation of ingredients, sauces, garnishes, vegetables, and other food items. Consistently follow recipes, portion sizes, presentation standards, and food preparation procedures. Ensure all food products are properly labelled, dated, stored, and rotated according to hotel standards. Maintain proper food temperatures and comply with all food safety and hygiene requirements. Assist in checking daily preparation requirements, par levels, and stock availability. Inform the Chef de Partie or Sous Chef of any shortages, quality issues, or equipment concerns. Operate kitchen equipment safely and correctly, including ovens, grills, mixers, slicers, and food processors relevant to the assigned station. Clean and maintain kitchen equipment, workstations, utensils, and surrounding areas to required hygiene standards. Minimize food waste and ensure proper handling and storage of unused food products. Assist with the preparation and organization of the kitchen before, during, and after service. Support the kitchen team during busy service periods and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment at all times. Follow all Four Seasons Food Hygiene, Health & Safety, and HACCP procedures. Comply with Four Seasons’ Category One and Category Two Work Rules and Standards of Conduct as set forth in EmPact. Work harmoniously and professionally with colleagues, supervisors, and other hotel departments. Attend training sessions and continuously develop culinary knowledge and technical skills. Perform any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chef, or Chef de Partie. Work Environment The Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is located in the iconic Kingdom Tower, a prominent architectural landmark in Saudi Arabia’s capital. The hotel features redesigned interiors that reflect authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship. Café Boulud is one of the hotel's three signature dining venues, offering a refined French-inspired culinary experience with a focus on exceptional service. About Four Seasons Hotels Riyadh Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh provides a bespoke experience through personalized service and hospitality. The hotel is committed to maintaining high standards across all operations, including its distinguished culinary offerings. This role is integral to upholding the reputation for quality and service at Café Boulud.

bc4e3a958849a673.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدكان عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة عمليات الشراء المختلفة، بدءًا من تحديد الاحتياجات وحتى استلام المواد، مع ضمان الالتزام باللوائح والمعايير المحددة. هذه وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع المختلفة وفقًا للإجراءات واللوائح المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات وتوزيعها على الموردين المحتملين، وجمع عروض التوريد وتحليلها. تشكيل فرق لدراسة العروض ومتابعة عملها، وتدقيق نتائج الدراسة لاختيار العرض الأنسب. إرساء طلبات الشراء على العروض الفائزة بما يتوافق مع اللوائح والإجراءات التنظيمية. متابعة استلام المشتريات والتأكد من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان صحتها ودقتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيق وحفظ جميع المستندات والسجلات المتعلقة بالمشتريات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المشتريات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق اللوائح والإجراءات التنظيمية المتعلقة بالمشتريات. مهارات جيدة في التفاوض والتواصل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تدقيق المستندات المالية والمواصفات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة الدكان. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الدكان.

bc5fe5373cae3671.description: About the Role Nazih KSA is seeking an E-commerce Specialist to focus exclusively on driving sales growth across Amazon channels. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The E-commerce Specialist will be responsible for managing and optimizing Nazih KSA's presence on Amazon, encompassing both Vendor Central and Seller Central platforms, including FBA, FBM, and Seller Flex models. The primary objective is to achieve sales targets and ensure profitable growth. Key Responsibilities Achieve sales targets and drive profitable growth across all Amazon channels. Identify sales opportunities and develop strategic account growth plans. Manage product listings, pricing strategies, promotions, and Amazon advertising campaigns to enhance sales and conversion rates. Monitor sales performance, competitor activities, product availability, and overall account health on Amazon. Coordinate with internal teams regarding stock replenishment, purchase orders, and fulfillment processes to support sales operations. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on Amazon sales experience. Demonstrated experience with Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central, including various fulfillment models. Proven ability to grow sales and consistently achieve targets. Strong analytical, Excel, and commercial skills. Availability to work full-time from Nazih's office in Al Khobar. Experience in the beauty, personal care, or retail sectors is considered beneficial. Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are a plus. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the Nazih KSA office in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

bc839ba3b40a059b.description: About Exequt Exequt is a consulting firm specializing in enterprise applications and portals. The company focuses on understanding core business issues to develop solutions that deliver immediate value. Exequt emphasizes transparency and communication, working in partnership with clients throughout project lifecycles. Role Overview Exequt is seeking a Cybersecurity Audit Consultant to join its IT audit team in Riyadh. This contract role, with a duration of one year, involves leading assessments of application-level controls, automated business-process controls, and interface and data-integrity controls across various enterprise applications. The consultant will work closely with the broader IT audit team. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute application controls reviews for ERP and business applications such as SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics, covering configurable controls, automated controls, and key reports. Assess segregation of duties (SoD), user access and authorization design, and sensitive access within enterprise applications, evaluating related remediation and mitigating controls. Test automated business-process controls and IT-dependent manual controls, and evaluate interface, data-conversion, and data-integrity controls between systems. Support cybersecurity audits by linking application-layer findings to broader technology and financial reporting risks. Evaluate application controls against COBIT, ISO/IEC 27001, and relevant Saudi regulatory requirements (SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, PDPL), documenting evidence to a review-ready standard. Draft findings, assign risk ratings, and propose practical recommendations, coordinating with client application, IT, and business-process owners. Contribute to the development of methodology, testing tools, and knowledge sharing for the application controls capability. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity audit, specifically with a focus on application controls within enterprise environments. Work Arrangement This is a contract position for a duration of one year, based in Riyadh.

bc89aa516c8a2a98.description: About the Role Trouw Nutrition, a Nutreco company, is seeking a Key Account Manager – Livestock for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves developing and managing customer partnerships by combining commercial expertise with technical livestock knowledge to build long-term relationships with key decision-makers. The Key Account Manager will work with strategic customers to understand their needs and translate animal nutrition solutions into measurable value. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow key livestock and ruminant accounts across Saudi Arabia. Build trusted relationships with customers, technical experts, and key opinion leaders. Understand customer challenges and translate solutions into commercial value. Protect and grow existing business in calf milk replacers and feed additives. Develop account plans and manage opportunities, pricing, negotiations, and forecasts. Collaborate with regional technical and product marketing specialists to support key accounts across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC). Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated commercial expertise. Strong technical livestock knowledge. Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships. Experience in developing and executing account plans. Work Environment and Benefits This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week, within an international and dynamic environment. As part of Nutreco, a member of the SHV family, employees gain access to a wide network of expertise and global career paths. The role offers a competitive remuneration and benefits package aligned with the local market, along with locally applicable leave and employee benefits. Opportunities for professional growth are available within Nutreco and the wider SHV Group. Application Information This position offers an opportunity to shape strategic customer partnerships in a significant livestock market. Candidates who combine market network, technical credibility, and commercial drive are encouraged to apply.

bca6e0f17e974e86.description: About Madarek Engineering Consultants Madarek Engineering Consultants (MDK Consultant) is a Saudi engineering consultancy based in Riyadh, holding a First-Class classification from the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing. The firm provides integrated engineering solutions in line with international standards, focusing on design, construction supervision, infrastructure works, and compliance management. MDK Consultant is committed to quality and aims to deliver well-designed, fully compliant projects across Saudi Arabia, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The Role of Architect MDK Engineering Consultants is seeking an experienced Architect to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves participation in the design, development, production, and execution of architectural plans, with a specific focus on sports infrastructure projects. The Architect will contribute to projects that align with the company's vision for innovative and sustainable engineering solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, prepare, develop, and execute architectural plans. Produce detailed plans, technical files, and execution documents. Participate in the design of stadiums, training centers, clubs, and sports complexes. Review and prepare plans, technical specifications, and documents submitted by contractors. Coordinate with structural, MEP, fire safety, infrastructure, and landscape disciplines. Verify circulation, access, emergency exits, accessibility, and user safety. Participate in coordination meetings, technical workshops, and site visits. Identify non-conformities and follow up on technical observations. Ensure compliance with FIFA requirements and applicable standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 7-10 years of experience as an Architect. Demonstrated experience in the design and execution of architectural plans. Familiarity with sports infrastructure projects is preferred. Ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Knowledge of relevant building codes, standards, and safety regulations, including FIFA requirements. Work Environment The Architect will work in a collaborative culture that fosters innovation and ownership, contributing to landmark projects across the Kingdom. This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this Architect position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

bca7216dccb48625.job_title: Key Account Manager Digital Health Solutions
bca7216dccb48625.description: About the Role IQVIA is seeking a Key Account Manager - Digital Health Solutions to join its Digital Health Commercial Team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on driving strategic growth by managing key accounts, fostering long-term partnerships, and delivering digital health solutions within Saudi Arabia's healthcare ecosystem. The Digital Health Commercial Team The Digital Health Commercial Team at IQVIA is dedicated to transforming healthcare through technology. The team collaborates with stakeholders across public, private, and strategic sectors to implement solutions such as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Population Health Management (PHM), Datalake Solutions, Care Management Platforms (CMP), and advanced analytics tools. The team emphasizes innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and a growth mindset. Key Responsibilities Manage and expand strategic accounts within the healthcare and insurance sectors. Drive sales and market penetration for digital health products, including EMR, PHM, and healthcare web applications. Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clusters, and insurance companies. The role ensures that MEP materials and specialized equipment proposed and installed by contractors adhere to project technical specifications, design drawings, international MEP standards, local codes, and client requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage and provide technical oversight for MEP construction materials, equipment, and system approvals. Ensure compliance of proposed and installed MEP materials with project specifications, drawings, and standards. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, Construction Management, Procurement Engineering, and other stakeholders for material review and approval. Oversee factory testing, site handling, preservation, and traceability of all MEP materials and assets. Review and track Approved Materials List (AML), Project Approved Materials List (PAML), and Long-Lead Items (LLI) for major MEP equipment. Manage Materials Governance (MQG) submittals, including Materials Management Plans (MMPs) and Quality Plans. Review Prequalification Submittals (PQDs), Material Technical Submittals (MATs), and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) procedures. Conduct physical evaluations and field verification, including material samples, equipment mockups, and bench testing. Perform Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and Material Receiving Inspections. Collaboration and Coordination This role requires close coordination with various internal and external parties, including Engineering, Quality, Construction Management, Procurement Engineering, Testing Laboratories, Independent Third-Party Inspection Agencies, Consultants, Contractors, and MEP Equipment Manufacturers, Suppliers, and Fabricators. The objective is to ensure timely technical review, approval, inspection, and full traceability of all MEP materials. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in material engineering, specifically with electrical and MEP systems. Location and Work Type This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

bc07e58bf6a97fa4.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking a Senior Test Lead for Automotive HiL Testing to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing and managing automotive Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) testing, embedded system testing, and related testing processes. The primary focus is on ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded systems within automotive applications. Role Overview The Senior Test Lead will play a critical role in leading and coordinating testing activities for automotive embedded systems. This position requires a strong understanding of testing methodologies and a commitment to maintaining high quality standards and project timelines. The individual will be responsible for developing comprehensive test strategies and collaborating with various teams to resolve defects. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate testing activities for automotive embedded systems, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project timelines. Develop test strategies, test plans, and test cases for automotive HiL testing and embedded systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects in embedded software and systems. Conduct performance testing, regression testing, and system integration testing for automotive applications. Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks for efficient testing processes. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members within the testing team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical automotive testing functions within HCLTech. The role involves working collaboratively with various teams to achieve project goals and ensure the integrity of automotive embedded systems. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Test Lead position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

bc156723eb40eb3a.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Human Resources Manager to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This is a full-time position open exclusively to Saudi Nationals. The Human Resources Manager will support the daily operations of the Human Resources Office, focusing on recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. The role also involves ensuring HR services meet employee needs and contribute to business success, while maintaining compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and operating procedures. Key Responsibilities Manage the recruitment and hiring process, including establishing contact with external sources, attending job fairs, and overseeing candidate identification and selection. Provide expertise to property managers on selection procedures and partner with vendors for effective advertisement of open positions. Administer employee benefits, working with unemployment services providers, preparing reports, and representing the property at unemployment hearings. Oversee employee development by supporting departmental orientation programs, ensuring cross-training, and utilizing on-the-job training tools. Facilitate new hire orientation to ensure a positive first impression and emphasize guest service. Maintain employee relations by assisting with communication channels, reviewing progressive discipline documentation, and addressing employee concerns through an "open door" policy. Partner with Loss Prevention for employee accident investigations and communicate performance expectations. Ensure legal and compliance practices are followed, including maintaining accurate and secure employee files, complying with the Privacy Act, and managing medical records confidentially. Facilitate drug testing processes where applicable and communicate property rules and safety policies through the employee handbook and regular meetings. Conduct periodic claims reviews with the Regional Claims office and represent Human Resources at the property Safety Committee to promote workplace safety. Manage Workers' Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and cost management. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi National only. 0-1 years of experience in Human Resources. Demonstrated ability to carry out daily HR office activities. Understanding of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development processes. Knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, and operating procedures related to HR. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and operates within a hotel environment as part of the Human Resources support staff. The position requires collaboration with various departmental managers and external partners to achieve HR objectives and support overall business success. Application Information Salary details for this full-time position will be discussed during the interview process.

bc4d76b53df5bacc.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجدول الزمني للخدمات اليومية والأسبوعية. التخطيط للجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين وتحضيرها. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أداء واجباتهم، مثل مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه لضمان توفرها. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة بشكل صارم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف على التنظيف والتدبير. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المهنية. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على العمليات. بيئة العمل يعمل المشرف ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التنظيم والقدرة على التعامل مع المهام المتعددة لضمان أعلى مستويات النظافة والترتيب في المرافق التجارية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم.

bc545c2436d2c82f.description: About the Role Laverne Group is seeking a Shipping Specialist to manage and oversee local and international shipping operations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves ensuring timely and efficient delivery of shipments through effective coordination with various stakeholders. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage and follow up on all shipping activities, from supplier dispatch to warehouse delivery. The Shipping Specialist will be responsible for coordinating with suppliers, shipping companies, warehouses, and internal departments to streamline the shipping process and resolve any operational issues. Key Responsibilities Follow up on local and international shipments from suppliers until their delivery to the warehouse. Coordinate with suppliers, shipping companies, and freight forwarders to ensure timely shipments. Track shipment schedules, departure and arrival dates, and maintain accurate shipment updates. Coordinate with the warehouse team to ensure smooth receiving processes and accurate shipment quantities. Handle shipment delays and operational issues by engaging with relevant parties. Update shipment information and status within the ERP system. Coordinate with Procurement, Warehouse, Inventory, Finance, and other related departments. Monitor shipping costs, quotations, and invoices. Follow up on customs clearance and shipping requirements as needed. Prepare regular reports on shipment status, delays, costs, and operational issues. Monitor the performance of shipping companies and service providers. Maintain accurate and organized shipping records. Support initiatives aimed at improving shipping efficiency, reducing lead times, and optimizing operational costs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in shipping or a related field. Proven ability to manage local and international logistics operations. Experience with ERP systems for tracking and updating shipment information. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment that requires close coordination with various internal and external teams. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

bc7fe8a8f453e4b5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الجودة لطب الأسنان عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، ووضع المعايير والمؤشرات اللازمة لضمان رضا العملاء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة لخدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات تهدف إلى تعزيز جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بما يضمن تلبية وتجاوز توقعات العملاء. تحليل البيانات والمعلومات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع عيادات الجودة لطب الأسنان. تتاح الفرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على تحسين تجربة العملاء. نطاق الدور يتضمن الدور وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء. كما يشمل تطوير برامج لتعظيم جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء ورضاهم، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

bcb9b1801fff147d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة توزين التجارية عن إداري مواقع إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان الأداء الأمثل للمواقع الإلكترونية، وإدارة المحتوى، وتحليل أداء الزوار، بالإضافة إلى صيانة الخوادم. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إضافة المحتوى إلى المواقع الإلكترونية بشكل مستمر وتنسيقه لضمان الجودة. توليد وتنقيح صفحات الويب والتأكد من خلوها من الأخطاء التقنية والمحتوائية. دراسة نشاط الموقع وتحليل عدد الزوار ومصادرهم (مثل محركات البحث ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي). وضع الخطط والاستراتيجيات لزيادة عدد زوار الموقع وتحسين تفاعلهم. إدارة صلاحيات المستخدمين الآخرين الذين يساهمون في إضافة المحتوى، ومراقبة جودة عملهم. معالجة الشكاوى والاستفسارات الواردة من المستخدمين بفعالية. إجراء النسخ الاحتياطي للموقع بانتظام للحفاظ على البيانات في حال حدوث أي أعطال. مراقبة أداء الخوادم بشكل مستمر والتأكد من عملها بشكل صحيح وسليم، ومعالجة أي مشكلات تقنية قد تطرأ. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في إدارة المواقع الإلكترونية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إضافة المحتوى وتنسيقه بكفاءة. فهم أساسيات تحليل بيانات المواقع الإلكترونية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إدارة المحتوى الرقمي. القدرة على تحليل البيانات ووضع الخطط. مهارات حل المشكلات التقنية المتعلقة بالخوادم والمواقع. القدرة على التواصل الفعال وإدارة المستخدمين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم، ضمن فريق عمل شركة توزين التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

bcc10f6a6eb5dbbc.description: About MBRF MBRF is a company that impacts thousands of families globally by providing quality and innovation in everyday moments. The company's operations are driven by its commitment to quality and the contributions of its personnel. The Role of Senior Line Leader MBRF is seeking a Senior Line Leader to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. The Senior Line Leader will be responsible for ensuring compliance with quality standards and procedures, managing the sanitization department's operations, and leading a team of employees. Key Responsibilities Guarantee compliance with established quality standards and procedures. Participate in decision-making for corrective and preventive actions within the sanitization department, addressing issues such as SSOP, equipment swabbing, inventory deviations, and KPI divergence. Plan, monitor, and evaluate job results, including coaching and disciplining employees. Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to sanitization and review results in monthly Target Check Meetings. Create Divergence Reports with clear action plans and defined timelines to achieve KPIs. Maintain a safe and clean work environment by educating and directing personnel on the use of control points, equipment, and resources. Ensure that health and safety guidelines are implemented and followed within the sanitization area. Manage personnel, the sanitization process, cleaning chemicals, and utensils, working to maximize the utilization of cleaning equipment and manpower. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing procedures and documentation for all Quality & Management Systems. Update Operational Procedures and Work Instructions according to process changes, update the On-the-Job Training (OJT) Map, and train operators accordingly. Assign tasks, monitor progress, and conduct skill gap analysis based on Work Instructions to develop operators in their areas of responsibility. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, within the Eastern Region. The role involves active participation in operational processes and team leadership. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are interested in this Senior Line Leader position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

bcdbfdcb052e10a3.description: About the Role Le Meridien is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Medina. This full-time role involves supporting the daily execution of general ledger processes and assisting clients in understanding these procedures. The position requires 4+ years of experience. Key Responsibilities Perform accounting functions related to account balancing, ledger reconciliation, reporting, and discrepancy resolution. Coordinate and implement assigned accounting work and projects. Conduct and follow up on Accounting SOP audits across all property areas. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws concerning fraud and collection procedures. Generate accurate and timely reports and presentations. Analyze information to evaluate results, choose solutions, and resolve problems. Compile, code, categorize, calculate, tabulate, audit, and verify information or data. Balance credit card ledgers and verify contracts for groups, performing credit reference checks for direct-billed groups as needed. Financial Management and Control Work towards achieving and exceeding performance, budget, and team goals. Develop specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish tasks. Submit reports in a timely manner, meeting all delivery deadlines. Ensure accurate documentation of profits and losses. Monitor all applicable taxes, ensuring they are current, collected, and/or accrued. Maintain a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets. Complete period-end functions each period. Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies, procedures, and efficient utilization of financial resources. Required Knowledge and Skills Demonstrated knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes. Proficiency with return check procedures, Gross Revenue Report, write-off procedures, and consolidated deposit procedures. Ability to stay updated technically and apply new knowledge to the job. Competence in using computers and computer systems (hardware and software) for programming, software writing, function setup, data entry, or information processing. Ability to use relevant information and individual judgment to ensure compliance with laws, regulations, or standards. Team Leadership and Human Resources Utilize interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others, advocating for sound financial/business decision-making. Demonstrate honesty and integrity, leading by example. Motivate and provide a productive work environment, imposing deadlines and delegating tasks. Maintain an "open door policy" and be visible in areas of responsibility. Understand how to manage in a culturally diverse work environment. Manage the quality process in customer service and employee satisfaction. Participate in interviewing, selecting, and training employees. Appraise employee productivity and efficiency for promotion recommendations or other status changes. Follow progressive discipline procedures as appropriate. Ensure the safety and security of employees and property. Monitor employee attendance and record absences/tardiness. Assist direct supervisors in achieving their development goals. Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures. Additional Expectations Provide information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates via telephone, written form, e-mail, or in person. Demonstrate personal integrity, effective listening skills, self-confidence, energy, and enthusiasm. Manage group or interpersonal conflict effectively. Inform and/or update executives, peers, and subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner. Manage time effectively and possess strong organizational skills. Present ideas, expectations, and information concisely and in a well-organized way. Utilize problem-solving methodology for decision-making and follow-up. Make collection calls if necessary.

bceca4fb0a6c09fa.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة مناف العقارية عن حاجتها لمحاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إدارة الجوانب المالية والمحاسبية للشركة، مع التركيز على دقة السجلات المالية والالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد القيود اليومية وترحيلها بدقة. إدارة حسابات الذمم المدينة والدائنة ومتابعتها. إعداد القوائم المالية والتقارير الدورية اللازمة. تحضير الإقرارات الزكوية والضريبية وتقديمها في المواعيد المحددة. مراجعة المستخلصات المالية لضمان صحتها. التنسيق الفعال مع المراجع الخارجي للشركة. متابعة تكاليف المشاريع العقارية وإعداد الموازنات الخاصة بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في المحاسبة. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة، وتصل إلى 10 سنوات. خبرة سابقة في العمل ضمن شركات التطوير العقاري. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة. يتوقع من المتقدم أن يكون لديه القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق في بيئة ديناميكية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة مناف العقارية.

bcec34fe17d62319.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث Holoolk@2030 عن أخصائي أول تحليل البيانات وتطوير التقارير للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على استخراج البيانات وتحليلها لإنشاء تقارير ومؤشرات تدعم متابعة الأداء واتخاذ القرارات الاستراتيجية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استخراج البيانات من المنصات التقنية والتحقق من جودتها ودقتها. تحليل البيانات المعقدة وتحويلها إلى مؤشرات أداء واضحة ومفهومة. تطوير تقارير رسمية تدعم متابعة الأداء وتساعد في اتخاذ القرارات. تحديد احتياجات الجهات المستفيدة من التقارير وتوثيق المؤشرات والفترات والتصنيفات والفلاتر المطلوبة. التنسيق مع الفريق التقني بشأن متطلبات البيانات والتقارير ومواعيد التسليم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تحليل البيانات وتطوير التقارير. فهم عميق لعمليات استخراج البيانات والتحقق من جودتها. القدرة على تحويل البيانات الخام إلى معلومات قابلة للاستخدام ومؤشرات أداء. المهارات المطلوبة دقة تحليلية عالية في التعامل مع البيانات. مهارات كتابة عربية مهنية ممتازة لإعداد التقارير الرسمية. القدرة على فهم متطلبات البيانات والتقارير والتنسيق الفعال مع الفرق المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على دعم اتخاذ القرار من خلال تحليل البيانات الدقيق والتقارير الواضحة.
